Hi Jagmeet Singh
The HMI installed on that Sicharge D is a DLogic Gen1 HMI, with CCV contactless and no AC cutout, code: 8EM5903-0AA01-7AA0
The customer just made a hard reset, but the screen is still black.
We might have to do a replacement with a DLogic Gen2,
on warranty
, as we know that specific DLogic Gen1 HMI is problematic.
Please provide us asap an answer.
Br, José
